caption:
So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.

Surah Ali 'Imran (3:139). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #AliImran #Hope #IslamicReminder #Deen

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 3:139, Surah Ali 'Imran, on hope and steadfastness. Not used by any prior post (checked against existing blankdiscussions meta.json files). Standing 8-language/10-slide format.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, single live call api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/3:139/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-02); slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields, no retyping.
sourcing.english: Edition en.sahih (Saheeh International), same call, byte-identical.
sourcing.chinese: Edition zh.jian (Ma Jian), same call, byte-identical.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, translator 'Unknown' per source so slide says 'translator not specified by source'. Byte-identical; artifact scan (double spaces, space before punctuation, leading/trailing whitespace, control chars) found none, so no corrections were needed.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, translator 'Unknown' per source, byte-identical, same artifact scan clean.
sourcing.thai: Edition th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), byte-identical.
sourcing.verification_note: Live fetch performed this session in the same script that wrote the slide files. No wording from memory.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 139 string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across slide text and caption, word-boundary regex: 0 hits. No em/en dashes, no emoji.

theme_note: All 34 prior themes used; mulberry-seafoam (Mulberry & Seafoam) added as the 35th.

hosting_verified.note: Visually spot-checked Arabic (02), Chinese (04), Korean (05), Japanese (06), Thai (08): no tofu or missing glyphs. Hosting URLs verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg, no redirect (slides 01, 02, 05, 10).
